checks: Exact named tests in native-commands.json; paired source syntax
cost: groups O(n) singleton storage or O(1) Block. drop_class O(n^2) worst-case ancestor walking, O(n) vectors. run cost sums segmentation, annotation, frame realization, alignments, world passes and text diffs; retained intermediate payload is proportional to all generated representations, not streaming constant memory.
description: groups partitions sentence indices by Unit. run segments and annotates, reads frames with context groups, realizes/world-encodes with world groups, then exact decodes R4->R3->R2->R1; normal mode independently compares starts. damage edits first eligible residual; drop_class maps surviving heads past removed ancestors.
forward: groups partitions sentence indices by Unit. run segments and annotates, reads frames with context groups, realizes/world-encodes with world groups, then exact decodes R4->R3->R2->R1; normal mode independently compares starts. damage edits first eligible residual; drop_class maps surviving heads past removed ancestors.
inverse: Exact output with all intermediate residuals and unchanged decoders admits original trees/frames/tokens as reconstruction witnesses. Tally alone collapses volumes and cannot recover them. Unit World and Sentence share singleton worlds but differ reader contexts.

Exact_ok requires final text equality and no earlier frames/tree/token mismatch; a tree mismatch is not decoded further. Normal text scores do not establish exact recovery, semantic understanding or retained knowledge.
limitations: No annotator/model loading, live corpus, full suite, teacher, GPU or persistent-learning evidence. No executable percentage surrogate: categorical codecs/effects need a useful metric before future caps 1/2/5/10%.
